programs.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
programs.desc: To allow Alix to celebrate her birthday with her friends and family, Marinette gets the Rabbit Miraculous back and becomes the Keeper of Time for a few hours.

programs.title: Looney Tunes: Back in Action
programs.desc: This animated adventure comedy sees the demanding Daffy Duck team up with a studio security guard for an adventure in Las Vegas, while Bugs Bunny and their studio executive try to get Daffy back on set. Sick of being an offsider to star Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck storms off the set of their latest movie and insists on being given his own starring role, but his plan backfires when the studio shows him the door. He finds studio security guard DJ Drake in the same boat, and the two head to Las Vegas on a mission for DJ's father, an actor and sometime spy, but in hot pursuit is young studio executive Kate Houghton, who is now in trouble for firing Daffy, and must get him back at all costs.

programs.title: Caper Crew
programs.sub_title: If It Looks Too Good to be True, it is
programs.desc: When Ophelbert loses his beloved NuggieFunTime card at a swap meet, the Joeys discover forger extraordinaire, Scribbler. They have to get to him before anyone else does.

programs.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent Down Under
programs.desc: Phil heads to the Sunshine Coast - with its forty miles of stunning white sandy beaches - in order to help the Hanson Family find their piece of paradise down under.

programs.title: My Family
programs.desc: Ben and Susan look forward to a night out in a town where nobody knows their names when they visit daughter Janey, who is away at university. Booking into a hotel under the names of Johnny Studd and Delores de Large, the stage is set for a night full of surprises, of one kind or another.

programs.title: Coming To America
programs.desc: Join an African Prince on an unforgettable comic quest to the New World, it's time for him to find a princess, and the mission leads him and his most loyal friends to Queens, New York. In disguise as an impoverished immigrant, the pampered prince quickly finds himself a new job, new friends, new digs, new enemies, and lots of trouble.
